Camera Keybinds - choose ONE mod JAR

Check your Minecraft version in the launcher, then use the matching file:

Minecraft 26.1   -> camera_keybinds-5.0.0+mc26.1.jar
Minecraft 26.1.1 -> camera_keybinds-5.0.0+mc26.1.1.jar
Minecraft 26.1.2 -> camera_keybinds-5.0.0+mc26.1.2.jar
Minecraft 26.2   -> camera_keybinds-5.0.0+mc26.2.jar
Minecraft 26.3   -> camera_keybinds-5.0.0+mc26.3.jar

Put only that JAR in your Minecraft mods folder.
Requires Java 25, Fabric Loader 0.20.1 or newer, and Fabric API for your
Minecraft version. Remove older Camera Keybinds JARs from the mods folder.
